caption: The drawing consists of two distinct horizontal bands. The upper band has a dark, nearly black background with a horizontal row of stylized flowers: yellow flowers with green stems on each side and a larger flower in the center composed of blue, green, and purple petals, all connected by green stems and leaves. Above the row of flowers is a border composed of repeating pink chevron shapes. Below the flowers, there is a decorative border with a scalloped white line and evenly spaced turquoise dots. The lower band is broader and colored in a reddish-brown wood-like texture, with a sprig of green leaves and blue five-petaled flowers visible in the lower left corner, extending diagonally from the left side into the reddish-brown field. The drawing is bordered by a plain beige margin.
title: Stencilled Floor
